name: Shady Rocks
description: A deliberately dishonest demo vendor: it lists a copied item code and a counterfeit, to show what the buyer's verification catches. Every offer carries a zero-knowledge proof of possession that buyers verify against the Proove Artifact Registry.

networks.name: shady_vendor
networks.description: Match, prove possession, negotiate and sell certified artifacts.

agents.name: curator_agent
agents.role: Matches buyer requirements to certified inventory

agents.name: prover_agent
agents.role: Zero-knowledge proof of possession per offer, in the browser (rule-based)

agents.name: sales_agent
agents.role: Counter-offers within the vendor's price floor

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Public catalog: titles, categories, stated measures and prices. No item codes.

tools.name: request_offers
tools.description: Match the buyer's requirements and return offers, each with a possession proof bound to that listing. Non-binding.

tools.name: prove_item
tools.description: Generate a possession proof for one item (used by prover_agent and the storefront).

tools.name: negotiate_offer
tools.description: Non-binding counter-offer on a listing. Max 3 rounds; never below the vendor's floor.

tools.name: show_reference_image
tools.description: Display an openly licensed Wikimedia Commons reference photo for one of this shop's listings (sent by the buyer's image_agent). Only Wikimedia-hosted images with a public-domain or CC license are accepted.

tools.name: confirm_sale
tools.description: Sell a listing at the agreed price. The vendor owner approves; the item leaves the vault.

rpc.consent: Untrusted origins are asked once. confirm_sale always pauses for the vendor owner's approval.

llm.note: Proofs never depend on a model: prover_agent is deterministic.

demo_notice: Deliberately dishonest vendor for the demonstration. Its offers fail the buyer's verification.
